Handheld Emulation Suite

Custom Apps for muOS Andromeda

A cohesive collection of 5 utilities designed specifically for muOS on the Anbernic Allwinner H700 handheld family. Built on LÖVE2D and the shared fskit toolkit with native gamepad controls, theme synchronization, and robust data persistence.

Anbernic RG35XX Pro, Plus, H, SP, 2024•Allwinner H700
muOS Appv1.0.0

ClockMu

An alarm clock for muOS Andromeda on the Anbernic RG35XX family. Supports multiple alarms, repeat schedules, snooze, 15-minute presets, and 8 color themes.

muOS AndromedaLÖVE2DfskitAlarm ClockRG35XX
Explore details
muOS Appv1.0.0

JarMu

A "shake the jar" weighted random game picker for muOS Andromeda. Scans SD1 and SD2 ROMs + PortMaster ports, with in-app genre editing and retro CRT effects.

muOS AndromedaLÖVE2DfskitGame SelectorRG35XX
Explore details
muOS Appv1.0.0

BatteryMu

Live battery and health monitor for muOS Andromeda. Real-time charge %, voltage levels, health readout, charge history graphs, and AXP2202 sysfs fallback.

muOS AndromedaLÖVE2DfskitHardware MonitorRG35XX
Explore details
muOS Appv1.0.0

SwapMu

Per-game SRAM save swapper bridging Pickle and RetroArch. Features core bridging, side-by-side save comparisons, and 3-tier safe backup confirmations.

muOS AndromedaLÖVE2DfskitSave SwapperRG35XX
Explore details
muOS Appv0.2.0

ScrapMu

Box art and metadata scraper for muOS Andromeda combining Skyscraper template compositing (Retro Dither) with Artie-style rich descriptions via ScreenScraper.

muOS AndromedaLÖVE2DfskitBox Art ScraperRG35XX
Explore details
